journeyHub.metaTitle: Mioshy Journey — A Couples Journey Made for You
journeyHub.metaDescription: A short assessment, instant insights, and a personalized roadmap of practices and conversations — delivered over time. Together, at your own pace.
journeyHub.h1: A couples journey, made for you
journeyHub.lede: Generic relationship advice never quite fits your relationship. Take a 5-minute assessment and get a personalized roadmap — short practices, real conversations, and weekly challenges that move you from "we should work on us" to actually doing it. Five minutes a day.
journeyHub.resumeHint: You've got a relationship assessment in progress — pick up where you left off.

why.title: No more generic advice. A path built around you.

0.p: A short assessment maps your relationship across 7 dimensions. Your roadmap starts exactly where it needs to — not where a generic course says to start.

1.p: No content dumps. A new chapter opens each week — a practice, a challenge, or a shared conversation. Enough room to feel it, try it, come back to it.

2.p: Every piece is co-written with couples therapists. Practical, research-based, actually doable — not Instagram quotes.

3.p: Both partners see the same journey. Mark conversations, write reflections, and watch how you grow — together, for real.

0.title: Map your relationship in 5 minutes
0.body: 15 quick questions on communication, conflict, intimacy, and routine. By the end you'll see exactly where you stand — no jargon, no filler.

1.title: Get a diagnostic you can actually use
1.body: Instant results: your 3 strongest areas, your 2 biggest friction points, and the one thing most worth working on first.

2.title: Small practices, your pace
2.body: Short practices that add up to about an hour a week — depending on your time and bandwidth. Try them, check in together, and feel the shift at a pace that fits your life.

inside.title: Small practices that change a lot

0.p: Little connection moments — 5 minutes a day that build the couples muscle.

1.p: Guided prompts that open up places you don't always reach on your own.

2.p: One thing each week — an outing, a gesture, an experiment — that pulls you out of the routine.

3.p: Short clips from couples therapists, with space to write what came up.

faq.headline:
Got questions?

We've got answers.
faq.description: We've gathered the questions couples ask us most. Still didn't find your answer?
faq.item1A:
Mioshy is a platform for couples, backed by an international team of experts — couples therapists, psychologists, sexologists, and relationship coaches from around the world, with centuries of combined experience working with couples, intimacy, and connection.

Together they built an experiential way to bring relationships back to life — not in therapy, not in a course, but in the most natural way there is: games, assessments, and personal coaching tailored to you. With one clear goal — to build you a new relationship, full of intimacy, sex, and love. To bring back the butterflies you thought you'd lost.
faq.item2Q: Is this a substitute for couples therapy?
faq.item2A: Not exactly. We're a preventive solution — for couples who feel something has eroded but aren't ready to jump into therapy. If there are real crises, we'll also recommend a licensed therapist, and on some plans we'll even connect you with one of our experts.
faq.item3A: Depends on the plan you pick. If it's a game — you get online access and start your first night together. If it's the close coaching — you start with a 10-minute assessment and get a personal plan with monthly tasks. You continue month by month, no contract — and stop whenever you want.
faq.item4Q: How long until we feel a change?
faq.item4A: Couples report a change after the very first night — mostly in the conversation and openness. A meaningful, lasting change is usually felt after 30 days of consistent work. In short: faster than you'd think.
faq.item5A: Absolutely. All your data is encrypted and never shared with anyone — ever. We don't sell data and we don't show ads. Your privacy — and your partner's — is sacred to us.
faq.item6Q: What if my partner isn't on board?
faq.item6A: This is way more common than you'd think. Our suggestion: start with a light, fun game — without framing it as "therapy" or "a fix." Just "a fun night together." Most couples who start that way naturally keep going together.
faq.item7Q: What's the difference between the three plans?
faq.item7A: Online couples games: easy entry, access to all games on the platform, flexible monthly subscription. Close coaching with the experts: our most comprehensive plan — everything included: all games (including adults-only), personal assessment, tailored plan, monthly tasks, and direct support from the team. Adults-only games: exclusive bedroom games, purchased separately per game. You can mix — and many do.
faq.item8Q: "Close coaching with the experts" — is everything really included?
faq.item8A: Yes. On purpose. We built this plan for couples who want someone really with them — so we ditched the "paid add-on on top of paid add-on" model. Everything included: full access to all games on the platform (adults-only too), a 10-minute personal assessment with a relationship expert, a personalized plan, refreshed monthly tasks, and direct chat support from the team — for questions, hesitations, and the moments you need someone to say a word. No contract, no penalties, stop at any stage. We wanted to walk the whole way with you — because we really want you happy, in love, and with tools that work. This is the service we'd want offered to us.
faq.item9Q: Can I cancel at any stage?
faq.item9A: Absolutely. No commitment, no penalties. Cancellation is one click in your account, or a quick message to support. No questions, no hassle.
faq.item10Q: We're not married — does this still fit?
faq.item10A: Of course. Mioshy fits every couple in a romantic relationship — married, partners, engaged. The only criterion is that you want to deepen the connection.
faq.item11Q: Who is this content for, exactly?
faq.item11A: For now, our content and tasks are tailored to heterosexual couples — a man and a woman. We're working on expanding the content to all kinds of relationships, and hope to share an update soon.

reviews.item1Text: "I bought 'Questions We Never Asked' as an anniversary gift, half joking, half not. After 11 years I thought I knew everything about him. I was wrong. We discovered things about each other we never knew and laughed until 2 a.m. Wow."
reviews.item2Text: "We tried couples therapy before — it helped for a moment, but every session felt heavy. The minute we joined Mioshy's coaching, everything got light. Sharing and tending to the relationship became fun. Strongly recommend..."
reviews.item3Text: "We've been customers for 4 years. Every time I tell Yuval 'maybe we should cancel?' something new drops. New kit, new challenge, a game we hadn't seen. They just don't let us get tired of each other. After 16 years."
reviews.item4Text: "I'll put it like this — Monday-night talk in our house is now: 'what's the task this time?' Idan races to check Mioshy first. Something I never thought could happen with us."
reviews.item5Text: "I took my husband to a hotel for his birthday and suddenly realized we had no plan for the evening. I downloaded a Mioshy game, and it saved the night. We laughed, drank, and talked about things we'd never talked about. He still brings up that evening."
reviews.item6Text: "On Valentine's Day every restaurant was packed, so instead of going out we downloaded a Mioshy game at home. It was a way better night than any restaurant we hit this year. Seriously."
